# Austic Scrap & E-Waste Recycling

> Leading certified corporate scrap buyer, e-waste recycler, and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) provider in India with headquarters in Kolkata and operations across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Pune.

## Core Capabilities
- **E-Waste Management & Recycling**: Authorized electronic waste collection, component separation, precious metal recovery (gold, silver, copper), and eco-friendly dismantling under E-Waste (Management) Rules.
- **Office Scrap Buying**: Bulk procurement of obsolete office furniture, workstations, partitions, electrical wiring, HVAC units, server racks, and office appliances.
- **IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) & Data Security**: Secure IT asset decommissioning, certified NIST 800-88 / DoD compliant data destruction, hard drive degaussing & physical shredding with certificates of destruction.
- **Industrial & Commercial Scrap**: Heavy machinery, silent DG sets, industrial diesel generators, chillers, commercial AC plants, lead-acid & lithium-ion battery recycling, ferrous and non-ferrous metals (copper, aluminum, brass, iron).

## Geographic Service Coverage
- **Kolkata (HQ)**: Complete office dismantling, e-waste processing, warehouse clearance across Kolkata and West Bengal.
- **Bengaluru**: IT parks, tech hubs (Electronic City, Whitefield, Outer Ring Road), startup ecosystem IT asset recycling.
- **Delhi NCR**: Corporate e-waste, government tenders, industrial office scrap across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, and Faridabad.
- **Mumbai**: Financial institutions, corporate towers in BKC, Lower Parel, Navi Mumbai, and Thane.
- **Hyderabad**: HITEC City, Gachibowli IT corridors, bulk computer recycling and metal disposition.
- **Chennai**: Tech parks (OMR, Guindy, Ambattur), manufacturing scrap, and industrial electronics disposal.
- **Pune**: IT & automotive sectors (Hinjawadi, Magarpatta, Kharadi) scrap management.
